instruction: Show me how to download and set up the Yaru GTK theme from gnome-look.org for use on my GNOME desktop.

metadata.explanation: Task requires agent to install Yaru GTK theme from gnome-look.org and apply it using GNOME settings. Evaluator checks if gtk-theme setting contains 'Yaru' by executing gsettings command and checking the output. Uses existing framework functions (check_list metric + cache_file getter). Similar complexity to original task - both involve downloading theme from gnome-look.org and applying via GNOME settings.
metadata.verification: Verified that gsettings 'org.gnome.desktop.interface gtk-theme' is the same setting used in original task. Yaru is a well-known GTK theme available on gnome-look.org. Task is feasible and maintains same pattern as original.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly uses gsettings command to check current GTK theme, which is the standard method for GNOME theme verification
check_list metric appropriately verifies that 'Yaru' appears in the gsettings output using regex pattern matching
Expected value 'Yaru' is semantically correct for verifying the Yaru theme installation and activation
Postconfig appropriately re-executes gsettings command to get fresh state after task completion
Complete coverage: evaluator verifies the core requirement (theme is active) which confirms both installation and switching steps were successful
Regex pattern 'Yaru' will match both exact theme name and variants (Yaru-dark, etc.), which is appropriate flexibility
